title: W5 C3 early -- Floating sidebar
description: Does the work of T202 (plan docs/agent-work/2026-11-01-ui-wave-5/PLAN.md ### C3) before C2 (T201) is done: C2 is writing App state + preference; you add the receiving ProjectSidebar props floating/floatFit yourself. Write code + specs now; run the floating specs once T201 is approved (C2 wires App). Do not register team-serial-check-slot. Heavy runs (builds/Playwright while load > 100) take the mkdir lock node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/serial-check.lock + owner.txt; remove only your own. Private Playwright config/port; double-quote paths; no git stash/checkout/reset/restore; no installs; no commits.

handoff.text:
T209 (W5 C3 early, floating sidebar) -- BLOCKED on one change this worker may not make.

DONE (my files): ProjectSidebar.tsx props floating?/floatFit?; is-floating only when floating && floatFit.fits; width = min(prefs.width, floatFit.width); --float-width/--float-top/--float-bottom (viewport px converted to .app's box in a layout effect); prefs write spreads readSidebarPreferences first; pointer resize clamps to the margin's room while floating. floating.css: shell absolute from the window edge (hover strip stays at x=0), sidebar one --space-4 in, transparent background, no border/shadow, search/title row/group-actions transparent; unpinned hidden by opacity+translate (tokens), instant under Reduce Motion, inert while hidden; reveal leaves visibility out of the transition so the keyboard-revealed pin takes focus. styles.css: one line, .app { position: relative }. tests/floating.spec.ts: 11 specs + a screenshot spec (PW_SHOTS_DIR).

BLOCKER: useMarginFit never re-measures when the document appears/moves without a resize (project opened from Projects screen, CSS zoom, focus mode, destination). Fix = node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-c3/patch-key.py (FloatContext key + documentOnScreen in src/components/floating.ts; App.tsx floatCtx documentOnScreen = (mode==='read' || writing) && !versions, key = [project?.id, destination, active, pageLayout zoom, focusMode]). Idempotent, asserts anchors. Run: python3 node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-c3/patch-key.py .  Coordinator assigned it to T209 (msg #1040) but this worker's launch brief forbids App.tsx edits and the permission system refused; nothing was written to floating.ts/App.tsx/floating.test.ts. After it lands: rerun tests/floating.spec.ts on a real build (ui5-c3/browser.config.mjs, port 1860), then done -> review.

EVIDENCE: Real tree (ui5-c3/dist, real-floating-pw.log): floating 7/11; the 4 failures (continuous, 150 % zoom, split, focus) are the re-measure gap. Scratch s3 = real tree + patch-key.py: acceptance list 108/109 (s3-accept-pw.log); the 1 failure is the hover-emphasis crawl on Settings > Goals dropdown buttons (Manuscript, Local day): pre-existing on the current tree, reproduced with all C3 class/CSS/.app line removed (pre1-hover-pw.log); cause not identified. vitest designTokens/motion/hoverEmphasis 36/36 (unit.log). Fail-first: doctored copy with is-floating forced off + CSS import removed (not the literal pre-C3 tree) fails 9/11 (ff-noc3-pw.log); doctored marginFit without FLOAT_GAP fails the tight-margin clearance 268 > 236.5 (ff-nogap-pw.log). Contrast (contrast.md): nothing under 4.5:1 on --paper; minimum Plain light --muted 5.20 on paper / 4.78 on surface; all 8 swatches light and dark >= 5.66 on paper. Screenshots: shots/ 9 PNGs (Plain/Color x light/dark x page/continuous + narrow fallback), all viewed.

UNVERIFIED / KNOWN: native WebKit; Versions/History fallback has no spec (only the documentOnScreen rule in the patch); pin focus after keyboard reveal fixed for floating only -- the non-floating overlay likely has the same visibility-transition gap (untested); --float-top only updates when floatFit/isFloating changes (project tabs bar toggling alone would not move it); at <=240 px sidebar widths the overlaid group buttons now sit over the label with no backing (plan's no-surface rule). ui5-c3/refresh-scratch.sh and scratch-run.sh are superseded (refresh-scratch.sh contains an rm -r line that never ran) -- do not run them.

Registered but untouched by me: src/components/floating.ts, src/components/floating.test.ts, src/App.tsx (team.py has no files-remove; move them to whoever applies the patch -- C5 waits on App.tsx).

review.note: T209 C3 APPROVED (Node v22.23.3, serial lock held per run). tsc --noEmit RC=0 (ui5-c3r/tsc.log). vitest floating/designTokens/motion/hoverEmphasis 4 files 41/41 (unit.log). Fresh build ui5-c3r/dist. Playwright (pw.log) floating+sidebar-selection+scrollspy+layout+alignment+hover-emphasis+split-view+writing-aids+accessibility+appearance: 128 passed, 1 failed = hover-emphasis.spec.ts:99 crawl only; all 11 floating specs + screenshot spec pass. CODE: is-floating only when floating&&fits; width=min(prefs.width,floatFit.width); prefs write spreads readSidebarPreferences; drag clamp; reveal focuses pin; floating.css has no background/border/shadow incl search, title row, group-actions; z-index 4 (<Popover 40); only opacity/transform tokens; inert while hidden; no stroke/scale rule in floating.css; .app position:relative is one line; floating.ts documentOnScreen+key and App.tsx floatCtx/key/deps are present as described. HOVER CRAWL CAUSE (not C3): git HEAD (wave 4) baseline built in ui5-c3r/base-dist passes the same spec (base-pw.log 4/4). On the current tree an instrumented crawl (cur-pw.log line 30) shows the Settings Goal scope dropdown 'Manuscript' at y 862-900 with elementFromPoint = FOOTER.pane-footer, :hover false, so hover never lands; the crawler's on-screen test (y+h<=900) skips scrollIntoView and the footer covers the band. 'Local day' reuses that shape's sample. The control itself hovers fine (probe-pw.log: stroke 0.52px, scale 1.04 after scrolling). Trigger is a ~35px downward shift of the Settings content, most likely the new 'Floating sidebar and research' checkbox row added by C2/T201 in GeneralSettings.tsx (I did not remove it to prove it; arithmetic fits: 862-35=827 is above the footer). Fix belongs to C2/T201 or the crawler (treat footer-covered as off-screen / scrollIntoView when elementFromPoint != target). FAIL-FIRST: real-floating-pw.log 7/11 pre-patch, the 4 failures are exactly the re-measure cases (continuous, 150% zoom, split, focus), right reason; ff-nogap fails tight-margin clearance 268>236.5 (right reason, doctored marginFit); ff-noc3 fails on missing .is-floating (older-tree doctored copy, ok). SCREENSHOTS (mine, 1600x1000, ui5-c3r/shots/own-*.png, all opened): plain-light-page, plain-light-cont, plain-dark-page, plain-dark-cont, color-light-page, color-light-cont, color-dark-page, color-dark-cont: sidebar text bare on desk/page bg, no fill/shadow/outer border, sidebar right 286 vs sheet 392 (continuous text 488), clear of format bar and topbar (geometry logged, no intersect), muted text legible in all 8; narrow-page and narrow-cont (1100px): normal grey panel; settings-fallback: normal panel. CAVEATS: (1) the sidebar's inner 1px --line hairlines between Read/Comments/History and above Settings remain in floating mode (wave-4 row separators; spec checks only outer border) -- owner said no border, so confirm this is acceptable or strip them; (2) native WebKit not checked; (3) Versions/History fallback has no spec; (4) --float-top only updates when floatFit changes; (5) the 'Recovered pending edits' toast appears in my shots after reload only (test artifact). Scratch only under ui5-c3r and the session scratchpad; no src/tests edits.
